title: About Tagly
story: Tagly started with a simple idea: the best marketing for a business is real people sharing it. So we built an app where businesses pay regular people for their reach, and people earn from their posts.
storyHighlight: the best marketing for a business is real people sharing it
storyTeam: We're a small team working on the app every day, and we read everything you send us.
storyTeamHighlight: we read everything you send us
rateBody: Rate us on {{store}} so more people can find us. Thank you.
